changelog: Agent memory: the agent remembers your projects across chats, with a memory screen and chat history
Skills & Plugins: install and manage Codex, OpenCode and Claude skills and plugins from GitHub
Faster file search and file tree, with symlink support
Website analysis tools (REA) and browser connection settings
Backup now includes your environment and SSH keys
Shizuku and root support next to ADB, with ADB auto-reconnect
Crash screen: a crash now shows a report screen instead of closing silently
Rootfs v2: faster setup with a mirror choice, plus community languages in Settings → Language
